task.prompt:
You are working with the attached current_procedure.sql and the attached change_request.md. Apply the change request in change_request.md to the current procedure exactly as specified there.

The procedure name and parameter list must remain exactly:
sp(para_Driver_ID integer, para_Name text, para_Age integer, para_School_ID integer, para_If_full_time text)

Return the complete stored procedure, and nothing else.

materials.text:
Summary: Add second-phase driver and school_bus updates plus ID 999 completion updates inside the existing true branch, add a Home_city update for older drivers there, and add an ELSE branch that updates Home_city for drivers whose Age is at least para_Age.

1. Inside the existing IF branch that runs when para_Driver_ID is less than para_Age, after the existing school_bus delete that uses para_School_ID, add the following sequence: set driver Name to phase2_A and then delete the driver row whose Driver_ID equals 101; set driver Name to phase2_B and then delete the driver row whose Driver_ID equals 102; set school_bus If_full_time to log_phase2_A and then delete the school_bus row whose School_ID equals 101; set school_bus If_full_time to log_phase2_B and then delete the school_bus row whose School_ID equals 102; set driver Name to phase2_C and then delete the driver row whose Driver_ID equals 103; set school_bus If_full_time to log_phase2_C and then delete the school_bus row whose School_ID equals 103.

2. Still inside that same true branch, immediately after the phase-two sequence, add two filtered updates: for the driver row whose Driver_ID equals 999, set Name to complete; for the school_bus row whose School_ID equals 999, set If_full_time to complete_log.

3. Still inside that same true branch, immediately after the ID 999 updates, add an update to the driver table setting Home_city to para_Name for every driver row whose Age is strictly greater than para_Age. If para_Age is null, this update must not affect any rows.

4. Add an ELSE branch to the existing outer IF. This branch is taken when the current condition para_Driver_ID is less than para_Age is not true, including when para_Driver_ID is greater than or equal to para_Age. In that branch, update the driver table setting Home_city to para_Name for every driver row whose Age is greater than or equal to para_Age. The existing true branch remains otherwise unchanged.
